decision: Declare the legacy English Wiktionary intake as CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wiktionary text is also available under the GFDL), attributed to Wiktionary contributors, with the exact frozen snapshot identified by checksum.

snapshot.dump_date_note: The Wiktionary dump date of this extraction was not recorded when it was downloaded. The snapshot is identified only by its checksum; it was obtained no later than 2026-08-22. No dump date is asserted.

terms.basis: Wiktionary text is published under CC BY-SA 4.0 and the GFDL (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Copyrights); Kaikki/Wiktextract extractions carry the same terms.
terms.attribution: Wiktionary contributors. Each record's headword page on en.wiktionary.org gives its contributor history; the page as it exists today may differ from the extracted snapshot.
terms.adaptations: Arca's normalizations, segmentations and corrections of these records are adaptations and are distributed under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 terms.
